title: delivery
description: The structured result an implementing role ends its answer with. Parsed by supervisor/_vendor/contract.py result_object(text, 'delivery'); the claude_cli adapter may add 'permission_denials' before writing runs/<task>/<attempt>/result.json, so that key is part of the schema. 'status' is advisory: deterministic verification (supervisor/verify.py) and the required reviews decide the task status, never this field.

status.description: COMPLETE = every acceptance criterion met and the declared tests pass. PARTIAL = usable work, something named in 'notes' is missing. BLOCKED = an external dependency, permission or decision is required. FAILED = the approach did not work.

artifacts.description: Repository-relative paths that were created or changed, forward slashes. Verification checks that each one exists and lies inside the task's owned paths.

notes.description: One paragraph: what was done, what was left out and why, what the next attempt should know.

decisions.description: Decision records proposed by this delivery (plan 9 Decision). Empty for ordinary implementation work.

tests.description: Declared tests actually run in this attempt, with their exit codes, so verification can confirm the success marker.

issues.description: Problems worth an issue record that are outside this task's scope.

permission_denials.description: Added by the adapter, not by the agent: tool calls the permission layer denied during the attempt (visible, never fatal).

handoff.description: Path to the HANDOFF.md written when the attempt stopped early.

repo_path.description: Repository-relative POSIX path: no drive letter, no leading slash, no backslashes.
